company.name: Datree
company.shortDescription: Datree is the creator of a git-centric DevOps management platform.
company.description: Datree is the creator of a git-centric DevOps management platform that allows for scaling without sacrificing visibility, information flow, or quality. The company's technology maps all code components, repositories, and committers while identifying their cross-connectivity to create a real-time, 360-degree catalog of the stack, allowing developers to optimize production with continuous delivery and a dependable flow of changes.
